Carlos A. Gimenez addresses actions on Cuba policy, Venezuela charges, and support for Florida farmers
U.S. Congressman Carlos A. Gimenez used his Twitter account on October 7 and October 8, 2026 to address enforcement against business ties with Cuba's government, announce new federal charges against Venezuelan leaders Nicolás Maduro and Cilia...
Carlos A. Gimenez, U.S. Congressman representing Florida’s 28th district and a native of Havana, Cuba, has recently addressed several issues through posts on his official Twitter account. The congressman highlighted actions against those conducting business with the Cuban government, federal charges against Venezuelan leaders, and support for local farmers in Florida.
On October 7, 2026, Gimenez posted, "Thank you, Tax Collector @darielfernandez for your tireless work in holding the Castro regime’s accomplices accountable. Those illegally conducting business with the dictatorship in #Cuba will face the full weight of US law. We have ZERO TOLERANCE for this in Florida! https://t.co/1F1ENkiyIP".
The following day, October 8, 2026, he published another statement regarding developments in Venezuela, " ¡JUSTICIA PARA LAS VÍCTIMAS DEL RÉGIMEN CRIMINAL DE MADURO! Nicolás Maduro y Cilia Flores enfrentan nuevos cargos federales por conspiración para cometer tortura, incluso contra ciudadanos estadounidenses. ¡Décadas de torturas, narcotráfico y terror no quedarán impunes!".
Later that same day, Gimenez shared his continued support for local agriculture, "Honored to always work with our Dade County Farm Bureau to protect our hardworking Redland & Homestead farmers! https://t.co/PfJ9SYT3gM".
Gimenez has served as a member of Congress since 2021 after replacing Debbie Mucarsel-Powell and previously held positions in both the Florida House of Representatives and the Miami-Dade County Commission from 2005 to 2011. He graduated from Barry University in 1999 with a Bachelor of Public Administration degree and currently resides in Miami.
